bugs.what: doubleTriggers (cause: dies) is only read from statics on permanents still on the battlefield, so a creature dying at the same time as Teysa isn't doubled (her ruling says it is). Repro: Teysa Karlov + Zulaport Cutthroat + Grizzly Bears, destroy-all creatures → opponent loses 3, not 6.
